basis.governing_question: Which new point-of-sale system should Farmácias Lusas choose, and how can it be rolled out to run in all 40 pharmacies?

sub_questions.question: What do the pharmacies' process areas require from a new point-of-sale system?
Which point-of-sale system best meets those requirements and holds up in a business case?
Can the chosen system be configured, loaded with the pharmacies' data and run stably at a pilot pharmacy?
How is the system rolled out in waves until it runs in all 40 pharmacies?

work.unit: Process area mapped with its requirements

phase_work.why: Process areas mapped two at a time, in two rounds, between a start-up week and a synthesis week. Within typical 3 to 6 weeks.
Vendor shortlist, demonstrations and scoring run once, with one week at the end to synthesize for the gate; no formal tender assumed.

work.unit: System configured and tested for one process area
Rollout wave of up to 10 sites

phase_work.why: Four process areas configured two at a time, then migration rehearsal, pilot site, and four rollout waves of up to 10 sites, one after another.

sizing.levers: Running two rollout waves at once would shorten the engagement most; configuring fewer process areas before the pilot site is the next lever.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish what each pharmacy process area requires from a new point-of-sale system and where current practice falls short.

gate.label: Requirements sign-off
gate.decision: Go or no-go on starting vendor selection against the signed-off requirements?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Score vendors against the signed-off requirements and build the business case for the selection decision.

gate.label: Vendor selection
gate.decision: Which vendor's point-of-sale system is taken forward into implementation?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Configure the chosen system, prove it at one pilot pharmacy, and roll it out in waves to all 40.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the system as running in all 40 pharmacies and close the engagement?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given, so every duration is an estimate, about 33 to 39 weeks in total, to confirm before quoting.
Implementation is estimated at 21 to 31 weeks and planned at the middle, 25 to 27; more process areas or slower waves push it higher.
Process areas are assumed at 4; each extra pair adds 5 to 8 weeks across Diagnostic and Implementation, so confirm the count with the client.
No formal tender is planned in Design; if the client must run one or the contract is large, Design grows by 4 to 6 weeks.
